description: The binding object embedded in every expose: its required platform/format/location members, the platform and format enums, the closed bindingLocation property set (including the v0.7.5 Confluent Tableflow, Iceberg catalog-profile, Redshift Serverless and Kinesis fields), icebergConfig's own structure -- writeVersion/fileFormat enums, its closed property set, and the partitionSpec/sortOrder arrays' per-entry required fields and enums -- and the v0.7.5 pgvector additions: platform pgvector, format pgvector_table, and vectorConfig's closed property set, required dimensions and its inclusive 1..16000 bounds, its vectorType/indexType/distanceMetric enums, and the closed hnsw/ivfflat parameter objects with their minimums. Also documents that the schema does not cross-validate platform against format or location fields against platform.
